scope.assigned_title: Heart-Disease Risk — Domain-Structured Bayesian Network vs Neural Network
scope.prediction_task: Historical disease-presence classification: num > 0, not future-event risk
scope.stage0_authorization: Create only this file, config/bn_graph.json, docs/validation_protocol.md, and docs/bn_design.md; stop before Stage 1

data_contract.deduplication: Keep first occurrence in source order, comparing all original columns except id; preserve source IDs and removed-row lineage
data_contract.deterministic_cleaning: Preserve existing zero-to-missing conventions for trestbps/chol and boolean normalization; reject invalid schema/labels before modeling
data_contract.patient_linkage: Unavailable; source row IDs are not verified patient identifiers; exact-record deduplication does not establish patient independence

historical_split.holdout_status: Already reported and inspected; any future results are retrospective evaluation, not newly untouched validation
holdout_restrictions: No reshuffling to claim a fresh holdout

development_split.input: D in its reconstructed split order
development_split.selection_use: Nested family comparison, hyperparameter search, all learned transformations and model fitting
development_split.threshold_use: Probabilities from frozen S-fitted models and decision-threshold selection only

partitions.manifest_requirement: Persist exact source IDs, order, duplicate lineage, partition and inner/outer-fold membership before fitting; expected counts are assertions to verify, not partitions already generated in Stage 0

inner_candidate_ranking: Highest unweighted mean inner-fold F1 at probability >= 0.50
Lexicographically smallest canonical JSON parameter object
selection.outer_procedure: For each fixed family and outer fold: search only outer-training rows, refit its inner winner there, then predict outer-validation rows exactly once
family_ranking: Highest unweighted mean outer-fold F1 at probability >= 0.50
selection.tie_numeric_policy: Exact equality of full-precision finite scores; no display rounding or tolerance-based tie grouping
selection.canonical_parameter_policy: json.dumps(params, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False), compared as strings; expand only JSON-native scalar values
selection.final_fit: After family selection, search each family's grid on all S using final_search_cv and the inner_candidate_ranking rule; refit each winner on S only
selection.deployment_selection: Choose family on S before accessing C probabilities/labels for cutoff development; C and T rankings cannot replace it
selection.oof_reporting: Save each family's nested OOF probabilities and fold assignments; pooled OOF metrics are secondary, not the family-ranking statistic
selection.selection_bias_disclosure: The winning family's outer-CV score is still selected across families and is not an independent performance estimate for that selection
selection.failure_policy: Fail closed for an invalid candidate, fit failure, undefined selection metric or insufficient class support; do not silently drop families, alter folds or change grids

models.baseline_preprocessing: Existing numeric median imputation with indicators and StandardScaler; categorical mode imputation and dense unknown-tolerant one-hot encoding; fitted inside every CV fit
models.parallelism: One estimator thread; one CV worker by default; any increased worker budget must be explicit and recorded
models.bn_grid_status: Unresolved; finalize smoothing and binning policy after graph/missing-data review, before any comparative experiment
models.calibration: Assess raw probabilities; no fitted recalibrator in the initial protocol
models.fairness: Same eligible rows, eleven raw predictors, partitions/folds, metric definitions and cutoff policy; model-appropriate representations and unequal declared search budgets

threshold_selection.partition: C for pooled development; C_H for a hospital experiment
threshold_selection.model_state: Frozen after fitting on S or S_H; no fit or refit using threshold rows
threshold_selection.objective: F1 on all threshold-partition rows, with zero_division=0
ranking: Smallest absolute integer distance from grid index 50
threshold_selection.applies_to: Each prespecified family separately; deployment family remains selected on S
required_outputs: Selected integer grid index and numeric threshold
threshold_selection.interpretation: Maximized threshold-partition F1 is a development objective, not a generalization estimate or clinical utility claim

hospital_evaluation.procedure: For each H, set D_H to its D rows; split D excluding H into S_H/C_H (75/25 stratified); repeat the entire nested family selection, final fitting and threshold procedure locally; evaluate every frozen family and the locally selected family on D_H
shared_objects_allowed: Fixed state vocabulary and search grids
hospital_evaluation.class_support: Require both classes in scoring partitions and sufficient support for every fixed stratified CV split; otherwise record not estimable and stop that experiment, without retuning the protocol
hospital_evaluation.role: Secondary D-only transport assessment; no hospital result may revise pooled choices, graph, grids or reporting rules
hospital_evaluation.comparability: Different populations/counts from the historical full-dataset hospital checks; report actual D_H counts, not the old site counts
hospital_evaluation.inner_cv_limitation: Inner/outer selection CV is stratified over rows of the permitted source hospitals; it does not claim additional hospital-disjoint validation

evaluation.final_label: Retrospective evaluation on the previously reported and inspected historical holdout
report_thresholds: Family-specific threshold selected on C or C_H
evaluation.probability_requirements: Class-1 probabilities must be finite and in [0,1]; do not clip stored predictions; record numerical clipping used only for log loss
evaluation.log_loss_policy: Binary class labels [0,1]; use float64 machine epsilon clipping only within metric calculation
evaluation.reliability: Five fixed equal-width probability bins on [0,1]; save bin counts, mean predictions and observed positive fractions; show empty bins and small-sample limitations

uncertainty.method: 2000 ordinary row-bootstrap resamples of saved evaluation predictions; percentile 95% intervals; no model refitting or threshold reselection
uncertainty.undefined_auc_resamples: Exclude only undefined resamples for that metric; report valid/invalid counts and null intervals if fewer than 1000 are valid
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional on the fitted model/split; not training-selection uncertainty, patient-cluster uncertainty, or a formal superiority test

evaluation.subgroups: Descriptive sex and age strata with counts and class support; no subgroup-specific optimization; finalize exact strata before experiments
evaluation.constant_reference: Always-positive decisions and constant class-1 probability estimated from S (S_H for hospital runs); report under a separate reference label
freeze_before_scoring: All grids, seeds, folds and partitions
Selected family, fitted candidates and thresholds

required: Code commit and dirty diff hash
Complete search results and fit failures
Nested OOF, threshold and evaluation predictions
reproducibility.execution_gate: Future implementation must fail closed on unresolved material specification, mismatched data, missing manifests or unapproved workload; Stage 0 creates documentation/configuration only, not an executable guard
reproducibility.amendments: Version and explain any protocol/specification change before viewing new evaluation results; preserve prior snapshots; never silently redefine a completed experiment

open_questions.question: Is a functioning domain-structured BN mandatory in Phase 1, and what counts as domain justification?
Is the neural-network comparison deferred to Phase 2 despite the assigned title?
Is the proposed F1-first default-cutoff selection criterion and separate threshold partition acceptable?
Is a discrete BN with explicit statistical rather than causal directions acceptable, and which features/measurement stage are required?
Are retrospective historical-holdout comparisons and D-only hospital checks acceptable given prior test exposure?
What title, authorship, contribution evidence, report length/template and presentation constraints apply?
Supply exact merged-CSV provenance, transformation history/license and any patient-linkage evidence
Resolve graph edges, independences, binning, smoothing grid and training/inference missingness assumptions
Finalize descriptive subgroup strata, BN library/version and experiment resource budget before runs
